eecircuits.component.property.barretter_: Constant current held by the tube
eecircuits.component.property.current.su: Maximum current that this component can handle for prolonged periods of time
eecircuits.component.property.current_fu: Current at which the fuse blows
eecircuits.component.property.diode_vb.s: Reverse breakdown voltage of the diode
eecircuits.component.property.edge_conne: Enable connecting circuit boards together at their edges
eecircuits.component.property.gauge_equa: Equation to be applied to the measured voltage before displaying it
eecircuits.component.property.label: Label
eecircuits.component.property.modular_di: Minimum current required to actuate this component
eecircuits.component.property.neon_tube_: Minimum current needed to keep the tube lit
Voltage needed to light up the tube
Approximate voltage held by the tube once lit
eecircuits.component.property.power.summ: Maximum power that this component can handle for prolonged periods of time
eecircuits.component.property.regulator_: Regulated voltage held by the regulator tube when it is lit and current is steady
eecircuits.component.property.relay_curr: Current needed to trigger the relay (calculated from the threshold voltage)
eecircuits.component.property.relay_pola: Whether the relay needs inverted current to reset itself
eecircuits.component.property.relay_thre: Voltage above which the relay triggers
eecircuits.component.property.thyratron_: Minimum anode current needed to keep the plasma ionized. Below this, the tube extinguishes and the grid regains control
How many volts the anode strike voltage shifts per volt of grid-to-cathode voltage. Higher values mean a small negative grid bias can hold off a high anode voltage
Anode-to-cathode voltage that fires the tube when the grid is at 0 V. Negative grid voltage raises this, positive grid voltage lowers it
Anode voltage drop while the tube is conducting
eecircuits.component.property.tube_ex.su: Transfer exponent; controls the curvature of the plate curves (1.5 is close to the classic 3/2 power law)
Amplification factor, controls how strongly grid voltage influences plate current. Represents the maximum theoretical voltage gain the tube can provide
eecircuits.component.property.tube_heate: Power requirement for the given saturation current
Voltage required to reach the rated heater power
eecircuits.component.property.tube_kg.su: Plate current scaling factor. Mathematical constant that defines how effectively electrons are drawn from anode to cathode. Lower values allow the tube to handle bigger currents.
eecircuits.component.property.tube_kg2.s: Screen-grid current scaling factor; controls how effectively the screen grid draws current. Lower values increase screen current at a given screen voltage.
eecircuits.component.property.tube_kp.su: Plate influence on cutoff, controls how sharply plate current is reduced as the grid goes negative
eecircuits.component.property.tube_kvb.s: Knee voltage; shapes the low plate-voltage bend in the plate curves
eecircuits.component.property.tube_satur: Maximum plate current that can pass through the tube before soft saturation clipping begins
eecircuits.component.property.varistor_v: Voltage around which the varistor starts to conduct major current
eecircuits.component.property.vertical_p: Enable connecting back to back circuit boards together
Controls the effect of gate voltage on channel current
Maximum current that can pass through the transistor before soft saturation clipping begins
eecircuits.component.property.vfet_kg.su: Perveance, controls channel current for a given voltage
eecircuits.component.property.voltage.su: Maximum voltage that this component can handle
